description: ADR-020 section 9. Requires Renovate >= 44.3.1: earlier versions skip minimumReleaseAge for digest updates, which would let a freshly moved tag or digest through unchecked.

Weekly schedule, one group per ecosystem, majors monthly and separate. Automerge is limited to test and lint tooling that is not bundled into a shipped artifact, and to GitHub Action digest updates. It is never enabled for runtime or crypto dependencies, the web build chain, node, pnpm, the gate tools in mise.toml, libwebrtc or uniffi.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh transitive pnpm and cargo lock entries monthly. https://docs.renovatebot.com/configuration-options/#lockfilemaintenance
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

customManagers.description: Rust toolchain pin in rust-toolchain.toml (no native manager)

packageRules.description: Cargo: one group for minor and patch updates
Rust toolchain: own PR, reviewed by hand
Gradle: everything that is not part of the Android train
Gradle: Android train (AGP, Kotlin, Compose, AndroidX) moves together
npm: one group for minor and patch updates
Docker: image and digest updates in one group
CI and dev tools: GitHub Actions and mise tools
uniffi runtime crate and uniffi-bindgen move together; own PR, never automerged
wasm-bindgen crate and CLI move together; own PR, never automerged
Slower release-age gate for libwebrtc and Gradle plugins. The Android app takes libwebrtc from the webrtc-sdk build behind the MediaEngine seam (ADR-020 section 4).
Automerge: test and lint tooling that is not bundled into a shipped artifact (devDependencies only)
Automerge: GitHub Action digest updates only, in their own group so a minor or major bump never rides along
Majors: monthly, one PR per package, never automerged
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Never automerge runtime or crypto dependencies, libwebrtc or uniffi
Never automerge runtime cargo and Gradle dependencies
Never automerge what is bundled into the shipped web client or server image, even though it is a devDependency
Never automerge the runtimes and the gate tools: a gate must not be able to update itself unreviewed
Never automerge Action minor or major updates (digest, pin and pinDigest are the only automerged types)
